title: scripts: offline verify + bench (repowalk/scripts/verify-offline.sh, repowalk/scripts/bench.sh)
description: Write verify-offline.sh (cargo tree must show no reqwest/tokio/LLM crates; grep source for network APIs; ldd binary if built) and bench.sh (time repowalk map on a target repo, prints files/sec + wall time). Owner of scripts/** only. Verify: bash -n both; run verify-offline.sh (it must pass or honestly report what's missing pre-build).
